```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameterized'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Root &ent;">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" sub:id="1">
  <!-- Parent level comment with special chars <>& -->
  <sub:child>
    <?sub-pi data="process-start"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unescaped markup: <tag attr="val">&base;</tag>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.ent">
  <!ENTITY % int_pe "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %int_pe;
  <?target-pi data="initialize"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://test.org/base" xmlns:ext="http://test.org/ext">
  <!-- Document root comment -->
  <ext:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with ENTITY reference &ext;
    ]]>
  </ext:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % remote SYSTEM "http://localhost/remote.dtd">
  %remote;
  <!ENTITY brand "Acme Corp">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Begin catalog items -->
  <item>
    <?catalog-action type="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block inside catalog item using &brand;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY sig "Manager">
  <!ENTITY % general_pe "<!ENTITY dyn 'Dynamic Value'>">
  %general_pe;
  <?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
]>
<note xmlns="http://w3.org/note" xmlns:custom="http://w3.org/custom">
  <!-- Confidential internal memo -->
  <to>All Staff</to>
  <from>&sig;</from>
  <custom:body>
    <?custom-render mode="fast"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Critical security update information: &dyn; <script>alert(1)</script>
    ]]>
  </custom:body>
</note>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item1 "Widget A">
  <!ENTITY item2 "&item1; and Widget B">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/inventory.dtd">
  %dtd_ext;
  <?inventory-debug log="enabled"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:m="http://inventory.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment -->
  <m:product>
    <?m-action execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Product inventory details including entities: &item2;
    ]]>
  </m:product>
</inventory>
```
